name: Firing
overview: Scripture teaches that believers may face unjust treatment and false accusations for Christ's sake, yet they are called to respond without judgment toward others, reflecting God's impartial love. Despite hardships, God’s purpose prevails, working all things together for good for those who love Him. Christ’s mission is to bring abundant life, contrasting the destructive intentions of the enemy, and believers are assured of God's sovereign care and fairness.
